sloka: नदी निलयनाः सर्पा नदी कुटिल गामिनः ।तिष्ठन्ति आवृत्य पन्थानम् अतः दुह्खतरम् वनम् ॥२-२८-२०॥
transliteration: nadī nilayanāḥ sarpā nadī kuṭila gāminaḥ ।tiṣṭhanti āvṛtya panthānam ataḥ duhkhataram vanam ॥2-28-20॥

translations.english: The serpents that live in and move like meandering rivers always obstruct the paths. Therefore, living in the forest is tremendously difficult.
